name: param
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Param instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Param tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Param through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Param Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Param only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
